verdict.rationale: First-party docs say everything in `skills/` is the source of truth, shared verbatim by every harness, and that porting never rewrites `SKILL.md` files. A hands-on probe copied a skill as a plain markdown folder into `.claude/skills/` and its frontmatter read back cleanly, and docs note a cross-runtime `~/.agents/skills/` alias recognized by Codex, Copilot CLI and Gemini CLI. missing for 10: carrying skills to a new harness with auto-triggering still needs a per-harness bootstrap injector and tool-mapping reference, so plain copying alone does not give full parity.

support.subject: As a developer, skills are plain markdown files and folders I can read, copy, and carry to another harness — not a proprietary binary format

citations.quote: Everything in `skills/` is the source of truth, shared verbatim by every harness.
it never reaches into `skills/*/SKILL.md` to swap tool names.
Skills are plain, selectively-installable markdown folders.
Codex, Copilot CLI, and Gemini CLI all also recognize `~/.agents/skills/` as a cross-runtime alias.
